Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
And Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,
提幔人以利法回答說：
“Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
Will a wise man make answer with knowledge of no value, or will he give birth to the east wind?
智慧人豈可用虛空的知識回答，用東風充滿肚腹呢？
Should he argue with useless words or speeches that serve no purpose?
Will he make arguments with words in which is no profit, and with sayings which have no value?
他豈可用無益的話和無濟於事的言語理論呢？
But you even undermine the fear of God and hinder meditation before Him.
Truly, you make the fear of God without effect, so that the time of quiet worship before God is made less by your outcry.
你是廢棄敬畏的意，在神面前阻止敬虔的心。
For your iniquity instructs your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
For your mouth is guided by your sin, and you have taken the tongue of the false for yourself.
你的罪孽指教你的口；你選用詭詐人的舌頭。
Your own mouth, not mine, condemns you; your own lips testify against you.
It is by your mouth, even yours, that you are judged to be in the wrong, and not by me; and your lips give witness against you.
你自己的口定你有罪，並非是我；你自己的嘴見證你的不是。
Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
Were you the first man to come into the world? or did you come into being before the hills?
你豈是頭一個被生的人嗎？你受造在諸山之先嗎？
Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?
Were you present at the secret meeting of God? and have you taken all wisdom for yourself?
你曾聽見神的密旨嗎？你還將智慧獨自得盡嗎？
What do you know that we do not? What do you understand that is not clear to us?
What knowledge have you which we have not? is there anything in your mind which is not in ours?
你知道甚麼是我們不知道的呢？你明白甚麼是我們不明白的呢？
Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side— men much older than your father.
With us are men who are grey-haired and full of years, much older than your father.
我們這裡有白髮的和年紀老邁的，比你父親還老。
Are the consolations of God not enough for you, even words spoken gently to you?
Are the comforts of God not enough for you, and the gentle word which was said to you?
神用溫和的話安慰你，你以為太小嗎？
Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,
Why is your heart uncontrolled, and why are your eyes lifted up;
你的心為何將你逼去？你的眼為何冒出火星，
as you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth?
So that you are turning your spirit against God, and letting such words go out of your mouth?
使你的靈反對神，也任你的口發這言語？
What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
What is man, that he may be clean? and how may the son of woman be upright?
人是甚麼，竟算為潔淨呢？婦人所生的是甚麼，竟算為義呢？
If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
Truly, he puts no faith in his holy ones, and the heavens are not clean in his eyes;
神不信靠他的眾聖者；在他眼前，天也不潔淨，
how much less man, who is vile and corrupt, who drinks injustice like water?
How much less one who is disgusting and unclean, a man who takes in evil like water!
何況那污穢可憎、喝罪孽如水的世人呢！
Listen to me and I will inform you. I will describe what I have seen,
Take note and give ear to my words; and I will say what I have seen:
我指示你，你要聽；我要述說所看見的，
what was declared by wise men and was not concealed from their fathers,
(The things which wise men have got from their fathers, and have not kept secret from us;
就是智慧人從列祖所受，傳說而不隱瞞的。
to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them.
For only to them was the land given, and no strange people were among them:)
（這地惟獨賜給他們，並沒有外人從他們中間經過。）
A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
The evil man is in pain all his days, and the number of the years stored up for the cruel is small.
惡人一生之日劬勞痛苦；強暴人一生的年數也是如此。
Sounds of terror fill his ears; in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him.
A sound of fear is in his ears; in time of peace destruction will come on him:
驚嚇的聲音常在他耳中；在平安時，搶奪的必臨到他那裡。
He despairs of his return from darkness; he is marked for the sword.
He has no hope of coming safe out of the dark, and his fate will be the sword;
他不信自己能從黑暗中轉回；他被刀劍等候。
He wanders about as food for vultures; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.
He is wandering about in search of bread, saying, Where is it? and he is certain that the day of trouble is ready for him:
他漂流在外求食，說：哪裡有食物呢？他知道黑暗的日子在他手邊預備好了。
Distress and anguish terrify him, overwhelming him like a king poised to attack.
He is greatly in fear of the dark day, trouble and pain overcome him:
急難困苦叫他害怕，而且勝了他，好像君王預備上陣一樣。
For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty,
Because his hand is stretched out against God, and his heart is lifted up against the Ruler of all,
他伸手攻擊神，以驕傲攻擊全能者，
rushing headlong at Him with a thick, studded shield.
Running against him like a man of war, covered by his thick breastplate; even like a king ready for the fight,
挺著頸項，用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闖；
Though his face is covered with fat and his waistline bulges with flesh,
Because his face is covered with fat, and his body has become thick;
是因他的臉蒙上脂油，腰積成肥肉。
he will dwell in ruined cities, in abandoned houses destined to become rubble.
And he has made his resting-place in the towns which have been pulled down, in houses where no man had a right to be, whose fate was to become masses of broken walls.
他曾住在荒涼城邑，無人居住、將成亂堆的房屋。
He will no longer be rich; his wealth will not endure. His possessions will not overspread the land.
He does not get wealth for himself, and is unable to keep what he has got; the heads of his grain are not bent down to the earth.
他不得富足，財物不得常存，產業在地上也不加增。
He will not escape from the darkness; the flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.
He does not come out of the dark; his branches are burned by the flame, and the wind takes away his bud.
他不得出離黑暗。火焰要將他的枝子燒乾；因神口中的氣，他要滅亡（原文是走去）。
Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness, for emptiness will be his reward.
Let him not put his hope in what is false, falling into error: for he will get deceit as his reward.
他不用倚靠虛假欺哄自己，因虛假必成為他的報應。
It will be paid in full before his time, and his branch will not flourish.
His branch is cut off before its time, and his leaf is no longer green.
他的日期未到之先，這事必成就；他的枝子不得青綠。
He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms.
He is like a vine whose grapes do not come to full growth, or an olive-tree dropping its flowers.
他必像葡萄樹的葡萄，未熟而落；又像橄欖樹的花，一開而謝。
For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
For the band of the evil-doers gives no fruit, and the tents of those who give wrong decisions for reward are burned with fire.
原來不敬虔之輩必無生育；受賄賂之人的帳棚必被火燒。
They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.”
Evil has made them with child, and they give birth to trouble; and the fruit of their body is shame for themselves.
他們所懷的是毒害，所生的是罪孽；心裡所預備的是詭詐。
